messages.subject: For Joakim Weidemanis and Katie McGinty | Sustainability, external relations and energy efficiency
messages.body:
Dear Ms. Canzanella,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Joakim Weidemanis, Chief Executive Officer, and Ms. Katie McGinty, Chief Sustainability and External Relations Officer.

Johnson Controls' energy-efficiency, decarbonisation and mission-critical infrastructure agenda operates at the intersection of governments, customers, sustainability commitments and complex project execution. Those priorities align closely with the work I lead today.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate combines government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory. I coordinate senior institutional engagement and complex stakeholder matters across corporate and technical functions, while also supporting governance around a major industrial renewable-energy platform and a carbon-accounting evidence pilot.

I would value a senior discussion about where this combination of sustainability, external relations, government engagement and institutional stakeholder strategy might support Johnson Controls' global priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Johnson Controls.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
